Thanks again for the demo last week. Our procurement and legal teams are working through the order form redlines. Two open items from our side that would help us move to PO: 

1) Insurance offset / insurance carveout: we’d like explicit language that allows Acme to offset indemnified amounts by the proceeds of our insurance. Can Redwood accept an insurance-offset clause up to the policy limits (we can share policy summary)?

2) Evidence and triage for third-party IP claims: to satisfy our internal compliance we need a clear process for evidence exchange (where to upload, retention, access controls) and any constraints on what Redwood will share with downstream counsel. If you already have a standard evidence manifest or staging bucket process, can you share it?

Attached: Acme-SOC2.pdf (SOC2 summary).

Appreciate a short note on next steps and whether you can accept the insurance offset language in principle so we can finalize the PO.

Thanks Rafael / Lisa — see proposed approach below. I kept this intentionally concise to speed acceptance; happy to expand if Acme’s counsel wants longer explanations. Attached is a tracked change file with the suggested redline for the order form indemnity section.

Proposed compromise (summary):
1) Insurance offset: Redwood will permit Acme to offset amounts paid by Acme’s insurers from damages recoverable under indemnity, but only to the extent actually paid by the insurer and not to exceed applicable policy limits. This is intended as a mutual practical mechanism (we will expect Redwood’s own insurance/offset treatment for claims Redwood brings).

2) Defense/control: Redwood agrees to take control of defense for third-party IP infringement claims where Redwood is the alleged infringer. Acme may participate with counsel at its own expense. If Acme seeks to control or retain counsel to preserve its rights, we can agree to joint defense protocols, but Redwood reserves right to select lead counsel where Redwood has primary responsibility.

3) Evidence exchange: Redwood can provide a secure staging S3 bucket (encrypted, access-logged) for claim evidence and a read-only viewable package for Acme counsel. Redwood will retain uploaded evidence for 2 years by default (we can negotiate longer retention under a separately paid retention addendum). We will not publish customer-provided evidence outside legal processes.

4) Cap/limits and carveouts: standard order form limits apply; no change to overall liability cap in this note. We recommend clarifying that indemnity obligations are subject to prompt written notice, cooperation in defense, and reasonable mitigation steps.

Please see attached redline_indemnity_ACME.docx for exact language. Jordan — can ops provision the staging bucket and share upload instructions and the evidence_manifest template?

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Compliance
Redwood Inference
kimberly.p@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.b@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.p@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form indemnity questions - insurance offset and evidence

Hi Lisa — operations here. We can stand up a secure evidence staging area in our AWS account that meets the requirements Kim outlined. Implementation details: 

- Provisioning: we will create an encrypted S3 bucket, enforce MFA delete on request, and enable CloudTrail logging. Access will be via temporary S3 pre-signed URLs or IAM role-based cross-account access (your preference).
- Retention: default retention is 2 years; we can set lifecycle rules to Glacier after 90 days if requested.
- Upload process: Acme will receive a single short-lived upload URL per evidence package or we can onboard a cross-account role. We’ll provide an evidence_manifest.xlsx template (attached) that we ask you to complete for each package — includes claim id, date range, custodian, file list, and origin statement.
- Point of contact: Rafael will be our commercial POC; please confirm your legal POC for evidence transfer (we will authorize only named individuals).

Attached: evidence_manifest.xlsx (template).

Operational note: please do not upload live customer data unless redacted — if privileged materials are included, flag them as such and we’ll restrict access pending counsel coordination.

Jordan Blake
Head of Customer Ops
Redwood Inference
jordan.b@redwood.com
